reviews.text: Just got my haircut with Joffrey and couldn't be happier with it. The cut came out super clean, looks great, and was exactly what I wanted. He was easy to talk to, professional, and clearly knows his craft. I left feeling like a million bucks and have already had people notice the haircut. Definitely recommend booking with him!
Joffrey is amazing at what he does. He gave me exactly what I wanted on my first visit which no barber has done before. Also, the hot towel and hair wash was amazing.

Joffrey was awesome. I was looking for a change and we worked together to find the right style that fit my features. It turned out so well and I feel very confident now!

He is also very friendly and easy to talk to! I highly recommend and will be coming here anytime I need a cut :)

I could not be more happy with my haircuts with Joffrey at Bespoke! I love the ambience of the place, they've got a cool bar and area to hang when you check in and everyone is very helpful and efficient in getting you comfortable and booked. I am so glad I found Joffrey for my haircuts because he takes the time to ask questions, discuss your hair with you, what you want and checks in during the cut as well. He also takes his time to be detailed and is so kind and funny too, so the conversation is always great! I don't think I've ever gotten this many compliments before for my haircuts, and it's all thanks to him! I'm so happy I found this place as my new haircut spot in Chicago!

I’ve had my hair cut by Joffrey twice since I moved to Chicago, and will be back when I’m due for another! Really, really great stylist who listens to what you want and makes you feel at home in the chair. Thanks, Joff!
I have enjoyed the privilege of Becca Schmidt as my stylist for four years now. My hair is the star of my show thanks to her. I also enjoy the option of a refreshing drink before now and then.

I’m extremely particular about my hair and I’ve been to so many salons in Chicago (Van Buren’s, Groom etc.) but Becca at Bespoke is leagues ahead. She pays incredible attention to detail and is an artist when it comes to cutting/styling. Cannot recommend her enough!
Joffrey did an awesome job cutting my hair, and he's also very nice and helpful. I highly recommend him!

Joffrey did a fantastic job! I’m super happy with how my haircut turned out. I have wavy/curly hair and had a specific request on how to tame it a bit. He executed it perfectly. He took his time and provided good info for styling/product options. And it’s very reasonably priced for the quality service you receive.

I’ve been living in Chicago for the summer and I’ve been seen Joffrey twice and couldn’t be happier than I stumbled upon him on my travels. Not just great at cutting hair, but funny, friendly and truly listens. If you are searching for a new barber, look no further!

I justified the price of this haircut based on the promised experience, but unfortunately the experience I received was very different. Based on the salon’s website and other reviews, I was expecting things like drinks and a scalp massage, but none of these were offered or provided.

I was also told by the staff that I should expect about 45 minutes of service, but I was finished in just under 30 minutes. Even the basic finishing felt rushed—they didn’t blow or brush off the loose hair after the haircut, so for the rest of the day I had a lot of cut hair continually falling onto my face and clothes.

Unfortunately, this was my first and last time here. For the price, the experience fell well short of what was advertised and what I expected.

I've lived in Chicago for eight years and have always gone to the same place for my haircuts, so this was my first time trying somewhere different—and it was an excellent experience. I booked a haircut with Joffrey Bolivar, and he was polite, friendly, and does a damn good fade. I’ll definitely be coming back!

First off, more barbers should serve whiskey while you wait. Secondly, I got lucky finding a newer barber there named Joffery. He did a great job getting my hair to match exactly what I had in mind. Anyone looking for a new barber should try him before he gets too many regulars.
Great service and very upscale barber with a convenient location! Joffrey gave me a great haircut!

Joffrey is an amazing barber if you’re looking for clean, sharp fades and expert beard trims. His attention to detail is outstanding, and he has a great eye for what works best for each client.

I’m glad I found Bespoke. The shop has a convenient location, welcoming atmosphere, and is an easy-going, LGBTQ+-friendly space where everyone feels comfortable. Highly recommend Joffrey if you’re looking for a barber who genuinely cares about his craft.
Joffrey gave me a great cut and was so friendly, highly recommend him! Just moved to Chicago and love this salon, it's spacious and has a great vibe. Looking forward to my next cut!

visiting and hubby Clyde needed a haircut.  Joffrey was terrific - listened to Clyde’s concerns and did an amazing job! Joffrey and Bespoke are now our official barber for whenever we’re in town.  Highly recommend!

I’ve been going to Bespoke since it opened and the excellence in service has never wavered. From the moment you walk in until the moment you walk out looking like your absolute best self, you are treated like an absolute king. Get there early, grab an old fashioned, peruse their awesome selection of haircare products, put your feet up and watch a movie… it’s like a man cave where you end up walking out looking phenomenal.
This place is great! Kimberlee is awesome and always does a great job. Can’t recommend it enough.
I was able to find an appointment with this barber, and my husband absolutely loved it. Thank you, Joff, for your excellent service and recommendation!

My wife told me I needed a new hairstyle. I visited Patrick for a consultation and a cut.  I brought in a few pictures. We discussed a few options.
He gave me sound advice based on more than 20 years in the business.   I like my new cut.  My wife does too.
Had a great cut and beard trim. Found my forever spot
Thanks Bruce!
Elisa was *chefs kiss*. No question about it, the Ultimate Grooming Package is well worth it!

I've been getting my haircut here now for a couple years and every stylist I've had an appointment with have been so reliable. The facilities and staff are also very nice. Overall a very comfortable environment to be in.

The stylists also read and record the appointment notes you give them when you book. So it pays off to go consistently and be honest/transparent about what you want.
Really happy with the haircut. Larysa is a great stylist.

Larysa was amazing in every way, I had a color & cut, first haircut or anything donesto my hair in a shop since hair transplant and she was fantastic explaing the color plan, the cut after the color process, and how to wash and style it with product she recommended as ee finished up. She was right on time for the consult and waiting for me right at 10am appt time for the main appt. She is super professional and fun to talk with too. An A+ 5 Star experience at Bespoke as a new Chicagoan in the South Loop! Recommend 100%.
Thanks Jeff!
Best place ever always gets it right

Being relatively new to Chicago, I was finally able to find my go to spot for haircuts at Bespoke!
Larysa always provides a great cut and comforting service!

Kimberlee always does a great job.
Thanks,
Chris
Thanks Mike!
Have been a regular client of Elisa for the past 2 years. She has done a great job with adjusting to different hair style needs, and is very enjoyable to be around. Highly recommend!

Honey, I slithered in looking like a tangled tragedy, and Erica turned my serpentine mess into a runway masterpiece! Even my snakes were gagged—quiet for once! She snipped, spun, and served shade at all the right moments. I left glowing, dizzy, and dangerously fabulous. If Erica can tame Medusa, she can handle anyone
Unfriendly experience with Becca.
Kimberlee is outstanding. I can’t recommend her enough.

The best place in town for a good haircut. Erica is amazing. She asks questions, genuinely cares about understanding the look you're going for, and helps you if you aren't fully set on something. The place looks like a cool speakeasy while being comfortable and relaxing.

Bespoke has a great vibe, they do great service, and overall it's a great place for a haircut. Very well worth it.

I had a fantastic experience with Erica!
Even though I didn't do a great job at explaining what kind of harcut I was lookong for she was great at understanding and asking the right questions. She gave me a great haircut and made me feel completely at ease throughout the entire appointment. She's incredibly professional, attentive, and clearly skilled at what she does.
Consistently great haircuts and a pleasant overall experience. Elisa is fantastic!

Larysa cut my hair and did an absolutely amazing job! She’s talented, detail-oriented, and really listens to what you want. I left feeling confident and looking great. Highly recommend her to anyone looking for a fantastic haircut!
got my haircut by Lisa today and it was a perfect experience! she is amazing at following photo references and pays very close attention to details and symmetry.

Love Bespoke Men's Grooming! I've been a client for about a year, beginning with an excellent stylist who has since moved on and now as a client of Ashley, the talented, funny, and down-to-earth owner. Kudos to Ashley and her highly professional Bespoke team for designing and running a men's salon that offers a wide range of terrific services as well as just the right touches of hospitality in a setting with a subtle masculine vibe. For example: as part of its overall rustic elegant decor, there's a den-like waiting area with leather upholstered armchairs, a tv, and a libations bar--although I've not had occasion to enjoy it for long because I've NEVER had to wait more than five minutes for my appointment. Bespoke also makes booking quick and easy through the Vagaro app. If you're looking for a men's salon that caters to working professionals and you live or work in the city and find it easy to get to the South Loop, check out Bespoke. I guarantee you'll be glad you did.
Thank you Antonio!

I have gone to Bespoke because Larysa has cut my hair since 2010. She is by far the best stylist I have ever had, and I ride my bike 20 miles or more to go to her wherever she's cutting. She is unusually precise and consistent, and very personable, too. I have referred men and women to her, and they have also had good experiences, so I cannot over-recommend her. She is 6 stars.

As to the salon, it is a typical high-end shop that offers what amounts to packages. A "cut" includes a straight-edge neck shave for men, the heated towel facial, etc, so it's pricier than a straight cut in other places. I pay it for Larysa because her cuts are so good they last longer. The music was very loud on my two visits, so it can be a struggle to talk to your stylist.

Thank you, Larysa!!

I visited Erica for the first time and she did an amazing job! She was very careful and attentive throughout the whole haircut. I really appreciated how she offered helpful advice while also being cautious — for example, when I mentioned wanting to cut my hair a bit shorter, she explained why it would be better to leave it slightly longer so it would style better after drying. You can tell she really knows what she’s doing. Highly recommend!
Needed a haircut before leaving Chicago and Erica did a great job. Would trust her to cut my hair anytime!
I get my haircut with Larysa, she is great every time. Always satisfied when I leave.

My husband, Raul, is extremely particular about his hair and has tried many stylists over the years without much luck—until he found Ashley. She consistently does an amazing job, and he always leaves her chair looking and feeling sharp. Every time he comes home he’s boasting about her. Her attention to detail, precision, and ability to understand exactly what he wants is truly impressive. Not only is she talented, but she seems warm, professional, and easy to talk to, which makes the whole experience even better. If you’re looking for someone who takes pride in their work and really listens to their clients, Ashley is the one to go to. Highly recommend!
Really nice, chill place. Pricing good and staff seemed to be talented

I've been a Bespoke client for many years now (time flies!), and I enjoy a wonderful experience every time I step foot inside their space. Becca is an amazing stylist and person, and she works her magic to make me look presentable (which can be a tall task!) and professional. The entire staff is kind and courteous, going the extra mile to make sure you're taken care of and comfortable while you wait. The place has a cool, clean ambiance. I love the ability to schedule a two-week touch-up. Booking an appointment is easy, whether in person or online. You can grab a drink (water, coffee, an adult beverage of your choice) and watch what's playing on TV while you sit at the bar or a comfy couch while you wait for your stylist. There might be a pup or two walking around to help ease anxiety by accepting your pets on their noggins. My experience at Bespoke is always smooth and comfortable.
Thank you Connor!
Had a consultation and a haircut with Larysa. Great styling advice and quality!

The best! For more than 5 years Becca and the Bespoke team took such great care of my hairstyling needs, and were just fun to be around. I moved out of state and had to end my regular appointments here after religiously visiting every 3 weeks. Very tough to say goodbye. Thank you and all the best, Becca and team!

TL;DR: Anisha is by far the best stylist I’ve ever had. She has helped me both love my long curly hair and enjoy getting haircuts.
--
For years, I kept my hair short because I couldn’t find anyone who could cut it properly. About 3 years ago, I came across Bespoke and noticed that Anisha’s profile mentioned experience with curly hair, so I booked an appointment. It was night and day. The cuts always grow out well (even up to two months later) and I constantly receive compliments on my hair. Beyond her skills, Anisha is a genuinely kind person, and I always enjoy our conversations during my appointments.
Bespoke is an incredibly relaxing place where they make you look good and feel good. Anisha is very, skilled, knowledgeable, and always a joy to be around.

The Barber Dalila is the best barber I've found in my 10 years living in Chicago. She's been my go-to barber for over a year now and always exceeds my expectations.

She communicates very well with her customers and is one of the most talented barbers I've ever gone to. She also makes sure that the cut is exactly what you want and is great at knowing the right style that works for you!

The salon itself is also very welcoming and I had a fantastic experience overall on my last cut. I can't recommend Dalila enough!

Elisa gave me a fantastic haircut and beard trim/line-up. She was very receptive to what I wanted, talked through what she doing/made sure it’s what I wanted, and gave me some great advice on how to better take care my hair. Probably one of the best haircuts I’ve ever gotten.
I fight traffic to get into the city from the suburbs so that I can have my hair cut/styled by Ashley!
Muhammad- we don’t have any record of you in our system or receiving a service with us. If there’s something that we have done to upset you, please let us know so we can make it right.

I’ve always struggled to find the right hairdresser because I’m pretty picky, but Ashley exceeded all my expectations. After searching for so long, I’ve finally found my go-to person! She did a fantastic job with my hair—exactly what I envisioned. Ashley is not only incredibly talented but also so amicable and attentive. She really listens to what you want and makes sure you’re happy with the result.

The ambiance at the salon is great, with a decor that’s both stylish and welcoming. The overall experience, from the services to the environment, is stellar. I can’t recommend Ashley enough!

This was my second time with Elisa, and I’m very happy with the service and the haircut. She’s very patient with me asking for different stuff, and she understood exactly what I was asking for. I haven’t had to wait for my appointment, the service is prompt - this is all I can ask for. Will definitely be going to Elisa from now on for as long as she’s working there.
Terrible customer service

Elisa at Bespoke Men’s Grooming is amazing! I have been going to her for years and have been beyond happy with her level of skill and expertise in cutting hair. She knows how to recommend the best style for your face and she is also a …

Kimberlee is fantastic. I've been going to her since pre-COVID and actually followed her to Bespoke from her previous employer. My hair is medium long length, and I'm very particular about how it looks and its cut. Every time I visit, she …
Love love love it here!! Elisa always has me looking fresh and gives THE BEST haircut I’ve had in Chicago. Hands down. Cool atmosphere, fun staff, good music, AND a bar?! What more can you ask for?
Elisa was great as always. She's always pleasant and is consistent every time
